svg.title: Generalized cross-validation with two minima
svg.desc: Left: the GCV criterion for the 32-channel problem against lambda on logarithmic axes has two dips, a deeper one near lambda = 7 times 10 to the minus 14 and a shallower one near 2 times 10 to the minus 7. Right: the reconstruction error against lambda is about 67 at the deeper dip and about 0.037 at the shallower one. The noiseless fitted-value errors at the two dips are both below 10 to the minus 4.
svg.text: GCV: two dips, and the deeper one is the wrong one for reconstruction
deeper dip: λ ≈ 7.2×10⁻¹⁴, reconstruction error 67, fitted-value error 9.0×10⁻⁵
shallower dip: λ ≈ 2.3×10⁻⁷, reconstruction error 0.037, fitted-value error 5.8×10⁻⁵
GCV estimates prediction error at the observed inputs. Both dips predict well there; only one reconstructs x.
